title: potentilla alpestris var. stricticaulis
intro:
Potentilla alpestris var. stricticaulis, commonly known as Alpine Cinquefoil, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Rosaceae family, characterized by its white or pink flowers and silvery-gray foliage.

This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and dyspepsia, as well as its use in traditional medicine to treat fever and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Cinquefoil include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
